raw_market.description:
In the first half of the college football game between Boise State and Fresno State, scheduled for October 10 at 10:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Boise State score 14 or more points in the first half.

If Boise State score less than 14 points in the first half, this market will resolve to "Under".

This market is based solely on Boise State's score, not the combined score of both teams.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
